decisions_and_actions.title: lib/workflow/runner.ts (runPool) unwired -- root-caused to stage.ts's 'diverge' stage building K candidates SEQUENTIALLY
decisions_and_actions.status: CLOSED -- parallelized 2026-08-25, verified natively (Windows) and in the cloud sandbox, zero regressions
decisions_and_actions.next_step: Implemented. The blocker was deeper than the recordCandidate index race alone: reconceptBuild and recordCandidate both read/write a SHARED outputDir (5b-design.json, site/), so naive parallelization would have let concurrent builds interleave writes to the same files. Fix: (1) lib/workflow/candidates.ts's recordCandidate gained an optional sourceDir (defaults to outputDir, every existing caller unaffected) so the design/site copy can come from somewhere other than the run root while the shared candidates/ index still lives under outputDir; (2) scripts/n8n/stage.ts's diverge case now builds each direction into its own 'shadow' outputDir -- entries symlinked from the real run (profile/content/evidence/assets), except the two paths a build writes -- run through lib/workflow/runner.ts's runPool, with only the candidate-id-assignment + index-append serialized via SerializedWriter; the expensive compose+render work runs fully concurrently. Also fixed a real bug this surfaced along the way: runPool's `results` is completion order, not task order (its docstring was wrong and is now corrected), so stage.ts matches results back to directions by id rather than by array position. New tests (test/workflow/candidates.test.ts) prove the race is real without the SerializedWriter and gone with it, plus a sourceDir unit test; the existing test/qa/p7-diverge.test.ts end-to-end test passes unchanged. Edited: lib/workflow/candidates.ts, lib/workflow/runner.ts (docstring only), scripts/n8n/stage.ts, test/workflow/candidates.test.ts (committed 019367f).

decisions_and_actions.title: MAJOR FINDING, RESOLVED THIS PASS: most of the real production codebase was never committed to git at all
decisions_and_actions.status: RESOLVED THIS PASS -- 5 commits, ~330 files added, one security fix
decisions_and_actions.next_step: While delivering this pass's doc corrections, `git status` on the Windows checkout showed 149 untracked entries where the standing assumption (carried since early this session) was 'a large pre-existing untracked/modified set, never touched, unrelated to this session'. Investigated in full rather than assumed: confirmed the untracked set included ~40 core lib/ modules (the ENTIRE lib/workflow/hermes.ts, jobState.ts, candidates.ts, ledger.ts, runner.ts, state.ts -- i.e. the whole JobState persistence layer and candidate ledger had zero git history), ~30 scripts/ files including scripts/n8n/stage-server.ts (the actual production HTTP server n8n calls), ~37 test files, and the docs/research/assets/config corpus. A fresh `git clone` of this repo before this pass would have been missing the majority of the working factory. SECURITY FINDING in the same sweep: .env.awwwards (live API keys for Gemini/Cerebras/OpenAI/OpenRouter/xAI/DeepSeek plus a Netlify deploy token) was present and NOT covered by the existing .gitignore's exact-match .env/.env.local rules -- a single git add -A by anyone would have committed live secrets to history. Fixed first, as its own commit, before touching anything else: added `.env.*` plus benchmark/, benchmark-10/, preview/, verify-director-enrichment/ (generated run artifacts, same category as the already-ignored output/) and .agents/ (local tooling config) to .gitignore. Then committed the real source in 4 more logical commits: lib/ (45 files), scripts/ (30 files), test/ (41 files), docs+root-corpus+n8n+research+assets+config (192 files) -- explicitly excluding bf-inventory.txt (a generated report) and the empty .claude/skills/. Deliberately did NOT touch the ~57 pre-existing genuinely-modified (M) files still sitting in the working tree -- confirmed those remain exactly as found, per the standing rule not to sweep up unrelated WIP. Verified before and after: native Windows typecheck clean, 1406/1406 tests pass (cloud sandbox shows the same 4 known pre-existing Playwright-dependent failures as every prior checkpoint this session). This closes a real, severe autonomy/resumability gap (FAZA 10's 'state+ledger+resume connected' and general disaster-recovery posture) using existing git hygiene practice, not new tooling.
